name: codex-session-control-plane
description: Upper-control orchestration for independent Codex parent sessions through App Server thread/start, persistent ledgers, and controller-owned review.

interface.longDescription: Create, address, and coordinate independent Codex parent sessions from an upper control plane. Assign each thread a project, model, and reasoning effort; relay cross-session messages; retain a durable ledger; and keep final acceptance with the controller.
defaultPrompt: Create a dry-run upper-control plan for independent Codex sessions.
Use 上位管制 to coordinate parent sessions for this project.
Inspect the control-plane ledger and pending reviews.
